name: Stock the parts you use repeatedly

pages.text: Once you can reliably make common components, keep a modest reserve. Plates, rods, wires and frequently used circuits appear in many projects.$(br2)Avoid processing every ingot into one shape just because a machine is free. Keep some material unprocessed so you can respond to a new recipe without reversing your work.
Ready to expand: you can find essential resources, identify your storage and repeat the basic processes without rebuilding them each time.
